verdict.rationale: Railway's own marketing says you connect a repo and it 'handles the rest', and that every pull request gets its own preview deployment, which shows Git-event-driven deploys built into the product. No evidence states that a push to a branch automatically triggers a production or branch redeploy. missing for 10: explicit documentation of push-triggered auto-deploys (branch selection, trigger behavior), detailed first-party docs beyond marketing copy, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can automatically deploy my app on every Git push

citations.quote: Connect your repo, Railway handles the rest. Auto-config, instant previews, no new tools to learn.
Every pull request gets its own preview. No surprises after merge.
